Kidnappings for ransom

By: Sinethemba Nogude | Paid

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Its an alarming trend,organised criminals targeting foreign businessmen -kidnapping them for large amounts of ransom.Carte Blanche investigates.

Summary:
Kidnappings for ransom in the Eastern Cape

The idea of being kidnapped or having a family member taken is terrifying , you might do anything , pay anything to ensure their safe return.
In movies, plots to kidnap always involve well to do targets , but things are changing , there is money to be made from the poor and foreign nationals , who don’t have private security…
Criminals are realising that kidnappings for ransom are a potentially high reward low risk crime. They will target vulnerable groups like foreign nationals.
But to put it in context, the latest crime stats that were released in February for 2021/2022- Kidnappings showed the biggest increase of all crime categories of crime , with 35,7 % increase ,. In the financial year there were 6837 kidnappings.
And more recently in the Eastern Cape, the Hawks are investigating 15 cases of kidnapping of foreign nationals. Many are never reported.


Treatment
I want to make the audience uncomfortable upfront. I want to unsettle the viewers from the get go… This will be done using general kidnapping videos, I will also be making use of re-enactments upfront to set the scene.
The case studies will be hidden identity for obvious reasons and we will use renactments in telling their stories.

metadata.Summary: Kidnappings for ransom in the Eastern Cape The idea of being kidnapped or having a family member taken is terrifying , you might do anything , pay anything to ensure their safe return. In movies, plots to kidnap always involve well to do targets , but things are changing , there is money to be made from the poor and foreign nationals , who don’t have private security… Criminals are realising that kidnappings for ransom are a potentially high reward low risk crime. They will target vulnerable groups like foreign nationals. But to put it in context, the latest crime stats that were released in February for 2021/2022- Kidnappings showed the biggest increase of all crime categories of crime , with 35,7 % increase ,. In the financial year there were 6837 kidnappings. And more recently in the Eastern Cape, the Hawks are investigating 15 cases of kidnapping of foreign nationals. Many are never reported. Treatment I want to make the audience uncomfortable upfront. I want to unsettle the viewers from the get go… This will be done using general kidnapping videos, I will also be making use of re-enactments upfront to set the scene. The case studies will be hidden identity for obvious reasons and we will use renactments in telling their stories.
